name: National Community Health Partners: veteran housing help (SSVF)
description: VA-funded Supportive Services for Veteran Families (SSVF, grant 14-AZ-157): case management, help keeping a home, rapid rehousing and short-term financial help for low-income veteran households. Serves: La Paz County, Maricopa County, Pinal County, Yuma County.
next_step: Call SSVF intake with your county and housing situation: whether you are homeless now or at risk of losing housing, and who lives with you. A second intake number is listed: 928-726-6022.
constraints: Serves only the areas listed; check that yours is included. Veteran-household, income and housing-status screening applies.
County and intake details come from VA’s FY26 SSVF provider intake list; confirm current service when calling.
